messages.subject: invalid JSON input
parts:
Hello.

I reduced to the following snippet a test case:

library(shiny)

server <- function(input, output) {
}

ui <- shinyUI(
    textInput("emailText", "", "")
)

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)


Copying and pasting (not typing) the following text "importadores ​italianos" the following message is displayed:

Error in fromJSON(content, handler, default.size, depth, allowComments,  : 
  invalid JSON input


Any idea?

Thanks,
Alberto
